bugs.title: "Click to restore sidebar" does nothing when clicked
preconditions: Signed in to the application with the automation account.
Application reachable at https://cloudapps-e2e.encoreglobal.com.
Crawler ran with writes ENABLED (safety.allowWrites = true).
Screen under test: Sales Tax.
stepsToReproduce: 3. Observe that nothing on the page changes.
bugs.expectedResult: Clicking the button navigates, opens something, or changes what is on screen.
bugs.actualResult: After the click the URL is unchanged, no dialog opened, and the page content is byte-identical — the control has no visible effect.

bugs.title: Field "Current page number" silently truncates input
preconditions: Signed in to the application with the automation account.
Application reachable at https://cloudapps-e2e.encoreglobal.com.
Crawler ran with writes ENABLED (safety.allowWrites = true).
Screen under test: Sales Tax.
stepsToReproduce: 2. Type 300 characters into the "Current page number" field.
3. Observe that only 1 characters are kept and nothing explains why.
bugs.expectedResult: A field that limits length declares it (maxlength, a counter, or a validation message) so the user knows the value was cut.
bugs.actualResult: 300 characters were entered and the field kept 1, with no maxlength attribute and no message.

bugs.title: 8 form control(s) have no accessible label on Sales Tax
preconditions: Signed in to the application with the automation account.
Application reachable at https://cloudapps-e2e.encoreglobal.com.
Crawler ran with writes ENABLED (safety.allowWrites = true).
Screen under test: Sales Tax.
stepsToReproduce: 2. Inspect the form controls listed above and confirm none carries a label association.
bugs.expectedResult: Every form control is named by a <label for>, aria-label or aria-labelledby, so assistive technology can announce it.
bugs.actualResult: 8 control(s) are named only by placeholder text or by nothing at all: input (Enter zip code); button[type=button] (AK); select (AK AL AR AS AZ CA CO CT DC DE FL FM GA GU HI IA I…); button[type=button] (All); select (All ALEUTIANS EAST ALEUTIANS WEST ANCHORAGE BETHE…)
